|---|---|---|
| ErmFastDataPreparator | certified | First step of the ERM/GeoFrame water budget workflow: from the DTM it derives the drainage directions, the river network and the basin of the outlet, splits the basin into sub-basins (the hydrological response units) and stores them, with their topology and the stream gauges, in the GeoFrame database. |

## Hydro-Geomorphology › LWRecruitment (12)

| Module | Status | Description |
|---|---|---|
| LW01_ChannelPolygonMerger | experimental | Merges the adjacent bankfull polygons in a single geometry for further processing. |
| LW02_NetworkAttributesBuilder | experimental | Simple call to the already existing module NetworkAttributesBuilder to create the vector of the network with hierarchical attributes based on an input raster network. |
| LW03_NetworkHierarchyToPointsSplitter | experimental | Creates the equivalent point shapefile for the input hierarchic line shapefile of the network. |
| LW04_BankfullWidthAnalyzer | experimental | Extracts the bankfull width for each section of the channels and adds it as an attribute to the input layer. |
| LW05_BridgesDamsWidthAdder | experimental | Correct the bankfull width of the sections of the channels where a bridge or a check dam is found, set the attribute with the origin of the width to the corresponding value. |
| LW06_SlopeToNetworkAdder | experimental | Add the local slope attribute to the input channel point layer. |
| LW07_HydraulicParamsToSectionsAdder | experimental | Adds to the layer of section points the hydraulic parameters of the transversal section. |
| LW08_NetworkBufferWidthCalculator | experimental | Calculate the inundation zones along the channel network following a power law for the new width based on the original widht and the channel slope. |
| LW09_NetworBufferMergerHolesRemover | experimental | Merge the inundated polygons to avoid strange perimeters. |
| LW10_CHM_AreaToNetpointAssociator | experimental | Calculate median vegetation height and total timber volume of the vegetation on unstable and connected areas of each subbasin. |
| LW10_SingleTree_AreaToNetpointAssociator | experimental | Calculate median vegetation height and total timber volume of the vegetation on unstable and connected areas of each subbasin. |
| LW11_NetworkPropagator | experimental | Label the critical section for the transit of the wood and calculate the cumulated volume of biomass in each blocking section. |
